groups.label: White & green blooms
groups.blurb: A garden mix of white roses, hydrangeas and lisianthus with green undertones.

items.role: White hydrangeas for the creamy body.
Green hydrangeas echoing the tabletop runner.
A touch of lilac hydrangea in the hanging piece.
White glory lilies with swept-back petals adding drama.
White lisianthus with soft layered blooms.
White mini daisies scattering through the greens.

items.role: Asparagus fern trailing from the hanging installation.
Weeping asparagus fern adding the long drooping lines.
Fine fountain grass falling in soft strands.
